```plato
//==
// # Material and margin members
//
// The interface obligations of `engineering.types.plato`, and the elastic
// constants derived from an isotropic material. Only `SafetyFactor` owes an
// obligation: it is `IComparable` on its dimensionless ratio, and a
// larger ratio is a larger margin, so the order on the carrier IS the order on
// the design margin — no inversion, unlike the utilisation ratios (demand over
// capacity) some codes use instead.
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Margins
//  - Isotropic elastic constants

library EngineeringMaterials
{
    //==
    // # Margins

    // Margins order by their capacity-over-demand ratio: larger is safer.
    LessThanOrEquals(a: SafetyFactor, b: SafetyFactor): Boolean
        => a.Value <= b.Value;
```
